item.title: Images in Posts
item.description: An image in a post is laid out from its own dimensions, and any image can be opened at full size in a viewer. This post exists to show both behaviours against real files.

item.title: Markdown Alerts in Posts
item.description: Alerts are blockquotes that carry a label. They mark a passage as advice, a caveat, or a hazard without pulling the reader out of the article. Hugo renders them from ordinary Markdown, so a post keeps its plain-text source.

item.title: Mermaid Diagrams in Markdown
item.description: Mermaid diagrams can be written directly in Markdown with a fenced mermaid code block. Hugo keeps the diagram definition in the page, and the browser renders it when the page loads.
